# XAA Hackathon Kit (v4)

> A spec-first prompt kit for building a Cross-App Access (XAA) Requesting
> App against the public xaa.dev playground, in any language or framework.
> Two login paths (OIDC + PKCE, or SAML 2.0 Web Browser SSO) converge on an
> IdP refresh token as the session anchor, then RFC 8693 token exchange to
> an ID-JAG, RFC 7523 jwt-bearer to an access token, and RFC 6750 bearer
> error mapping.

Agents start at `hackathon-kit/IGNITION.md`, which asks three questions —
protocol, app type, stack — before reading anything else. Fixed hosts:
`https://idp.xaa.dev`, `https://auth.resource.xaa.dev`,
`https://api.resource.xaa.dev`, plus `https://mcp.xaa.dev/mcp` when
`APP_TYPE=mcp`.

Easiest thing to get wrong from prior knowledge: **the IdP refresh token is
the session anchor**, requested via `offline_access` and sent as
`subject_token` (type `urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:refresh_token`) on
every ID-JAG exchange. The ID Token lives ~10 min and is *not* the anchor;
the resource authorization server issues **no** refresh token, by design.
Upgrading from v2 is exactly that change. Step numbering is offset by one
from xaa.dev's docs — this kit's Step 1 is their "Step 2".

## The kit

- [IGNITION.md](hackathon-kit/IGNITION.md): Entry point — paste into your agent. Asks protocol, app type and stack, then runs a six-phase build with one stop after login. Appendix covers chat-only tools without filesystem access.
- [SPEC.md](hackathon-kit/SPEC.md): The only reference. Hosts and discovery quirks, exact wire format for Steps 0/0b/1/2/3, URN strings, token lifetimes, ID-JAG structure and `sub`/`sub_id`, the eight-value ErrorCode set and decoding tables, redaction, the env contract, invariants, and all ten `TODO(confirm)` items.
- [BUILD.md](hackathon-kit/BUILD.md): Six phases — scaffold, login, exchange, call, UI, tests — with required surfaces, the hermetic test matrix, nine smoke probes, and the E1–E8 end-to-end scenarios.
- [DEBUG.md](hackathon-kit/DEBUG.md): Twenty-eight failure shapes indexed by path, plus curl recipes that isolate a client bug from a server or registration bug.

## Repo root

- [README.md](README.md): Developer help doc — what you'll build, Day 0 checklist, stack picker.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent digest per the [agents.md](https://agents.md) standard, auto-loaded by ~20 tools; [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) is a thin import of it for Claude Code. [.env.example](.env.example) is the env template — copy to `.env.local` and fill in.
